body.x: Hans Creative(www.hanscreative.com) introduced its SSES(Smart Security & Energy Saving) solution at Korea Electronics Show 2016, which runs Oct. 26-29 at COEX.

SSES solution is the solution that can do both PC security and energy saving. If the smartphone user goes farther away from the PC, it changes to energy-saving mode. Both the monitor and CPU can be controlled real-tie, and energy-saving mode activates in 10 to 29 seconds. It supports both manual and automatic modes, and the app can be downloaded from Google Play Store.
A staff at Hans Creative said, "Big-size monitors and CPUs consume so much energy. Since there are many people who use the PCs, using this app will greatly help save the energy."

Hosted by MOTIE and organized by KEA, KES 2016 is the major international electronics and IT trade show in Korea where the convergence solution in the leading fields like electronics, ICT, semiconductors, and display and industry and IT convergence, digital broadcasting, smart education, smart factory, and e-health is displayed.
